_comment: DDI-CDI -> CDIF Archive Distribution profile UML. Source: metadataBuildingBlocks/_sources/profiles/cdifProfile/cdifManifest/cdifManifestSchema.json (cdifArchive merged in; archivePartArray/Item $defs now local). This profile module describes how a Dataset that conforms to https://w3id.org/cdif/manifest/1.0 carries archive-style distributions: a schema:DataDownload (the archive file) whose schema:hasPart enumerates schema:MediaObject component files inside, each with optional size/checksum/about and optional data-description extensions. Diagram scope: only the archive-specific content + the immediate anchor points where it plugs into the host Dataset / CatalogRecord / DataDownload (those three are restated as minimal stubs; full definitions in CDIFCore). cdifCore is NOT composed here on purpose so the overview diagram stays tight; cross-profile registry handles the stub <-> CDIFCore links.

transformation.description: DDI-CDI to CDIF Archive Distribution Profile

targetModel.modelTitle: UML Model for the CDIF Archive Distribution Profile
targetModel.subTitle: Archive-distribution structure: schema:hasPart on a DataDownload listing component files (schema:MediaObject) inside an archive
targetModel.definition: CDIF Archive Distribution profile module. On any Dataset whose catalog record (schema:subjectOf > CatalogRecord) declares conformance to https://w3id.org/cdif/manifest/1.0, schema:distribution items that are schema:DataDownloads MAY carry schema:hasPart describing the component files inside an archive. When schema:encodingFormat includes 'application/zip', schema:hasPart is REQUIRED. Each ArchivePart is typed as schema:MediaObject (not DataDownload, since the parts are not independently accessible). Parts may carry size (schema:QuantitativeValue), checksum (spdx:Checksum), back-references via schema:about, and CDIF data-description extensions (cdifTabularData, cdifDataCube).
targetModel.mainPackageDefinition: Archive distribution structure: component files inside a single download.

package.name: Classes
package.definition: Archive-distribution classes: ArchivePart (the component files) plus the anchor-point stubs Dataset / CatalogRecord / DataDownload where archive content attaches.

package.name: DataTypes
package.definition: Inline value-object datatypes used inside an ArchivePart: QuantitativeValue (file size), Checksum (spdx).

package.name: Anchors
package.definition: Stub re-declarations of CDIFCore classes that this profile attaches to. Provided so the overview diagram can render the attachment edges without dragging in the entire CDIFCore class graph. Full definitions are in CDIFCore (cross-profile links handle navigation).

class._comment: Dataset stub - cdifCore::Dataset. Only the schema:subjectOf attachment to CatalogRecord is interesting at this profile's scope; everything else (license, distribution[], variableMeasured, ...) is in CDIFCore.
class.definition: Stub of schema:Dataset (full definition in CDIFCore). Re-declared here so the diagram can show schema:subjectOf > CatalogRecord as the attachment point for the cdif:manifest/1.0 conformance declaration.

class._comment: CatalogRecord stub - the metadata-about-this-resource node sitting under schema:subjectOf. The diagram needs to show that dcterms:conformsTo must include https://w3id.org/cdif/manifest/1.0 for the archive profile to apply.
class.definition: Stub of CDIFCore::CatalogRecord (the metadata-about-the-metadata node carried at schema:subjectOf on a Dataset). For the archive-distribution profile, dcterms:conformsTo MUST include https://w3id.org/cdif/manifest/1.0.

attribute.name: conformsTo
attribute.definition: dcterms:conformsTo - URIs of specifications this metadata record conforms to. MUST include the constant https://w3id.org/cdif/manifest/1.0 for the archive profile.

class._comment: DataDownload stub - cdifCore::DataDownload. The schema:hasPart property hangs off this class; the rest of DataDownload (contentUrl, contentSize, encodingFormat, ...) lives in CDIFCore.
class.definition: Stub of CDIFCore::DataDownload (a distribution that is a downloadable file). When encodingFormat includes 'application/zip', schema:hasPart MUST list the component files inside the archive.

attribute.name: encodingFormat
attribute.definition: schema:encodingFormat - MIME type(s) of the download. Including 'application/zip' triggers the requirement to populate schema:hasPart.

class._comment: ArchivePart - a single component file inside an archive distribution. Typed schema:MediaObject (not DataDownload, since these files are not independently fetchable). Required: name, encodingFormat. Optional: description, size, about (back-reference when this part is a sidecar), spdx:checksum. May also carry cdifTabularData / cdifDataCube when the part is a tabular or cube data file.
class.definition: A component file within an archive distribution. Typed as schema:MediaObject; carries filename, MIME type(s), optional size and checksum, and optional schema:about back-references when the part is a sidecar metadata file.

attribute.name: identifier
attribute.definition: @id - identifier for this part, typically a hash-anchor (e.g. '#abc123'). Used as the target of schema:about back-references from sidecar metadata files inside the same archive.

attribute.name: name
attribute.definition: schema:name - filename of the component file within the archive.

attribute.name: description
attribute.definition: schema:description - short description of the file content.

attribute.name: encodingFormat
attribute.definition: schema:encodingFormat - MIME type(s) of this file.

class._comment: QuantitativeValue - inline value-object for schema:size on an ArchivePart. isDataType:true (identity is borne by the ArchivePart).
class.definition: schema:QuantitativeValue - a numeric value with a unit, used for schema:size on an ArchivePart.

attribute.name: unitText
attribute.definition: schema:unitText - unit of measure for the size (e.g. 'byte').

class._comment: Checksum - inline value-object on an ArchivePart for integrity verification. Uses SPDX vocabulary. isDataType:true.
class.definition: spdx:Checksum - inline checksum payload on an ArchivePart for integrity verification.

attribute.name: checksumValue
attribute.definition: spdx:checksumValue - the digest value as a hex string.

association._comment: Dataset -> CatalogRecord via schema:subjectOf. This is the attachment point for the cdif:manifest/1.0 conformance declaration.
association.definition: schema:subjectOf - the catalog record describing this dataset's metadata. For an archive distribution, the CatalogRecord MUST declare conformance to https://w3id.org/cdif/manifest/1.0.

association._comment: DataDownload -> ArchivePart via schema:hasPart. Composition: parts have no existence outside the archive download.
association.definition: schema:hasPart - the component files inside this archive DataDownload. Required when schema:encodingFormat includes 'application/zip'.

association._comment: ArchivePart -> ArchivePart via schema:about. A sidecar metadata file inside the archive can reference (via @id) another data file inside the same archive that it describes.
association.definition: schema:about - when this ArchivePart is a metadata sidecar, references the data ArchivePart this sidecar describes (typically via @id).
schema:size - file size as a QuantitativeValue (value + unitText).

association._comment: ArchivePart -> Checksum via spdx:checksum. Composition: the Checksum value object has no independent identity.
association.definition: spdx:checksum - integrity-verification digest for this component file.
